verdict.rationale: Aleph is a SaaS FP&A platform, so a buyer could fairly ask for an interactive API reference; the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a public API reference, an API explorer or runnable examples, and every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404. The '150+ connectors, plus anything with an API' claim is about ingesting data from other systems, not about a developer API reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
